subject: Reserve runway bake-off: weekly capacity & commercial triggers
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Joe Thompson <joe.thompson@orbitai.com>, Linda Wu <linda.wu@orbitai.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Reserve runway bake-off: weekly capacity & commercial triggers

Team — attaching the latest Q4 pipeline snapshot and a one-page reserve-ask template. OrbitAI is now projecting a 3x token run in December if their pilot converts; they asked for a conservative reserved capacity ask by EOD Friday so procurement can start the legal/finance loop.

Key asks: 
- Ben/Laura: can you validate the runway numbers in tab "OrbitAI" (Q4_pipeline_snapshot.xlsx) and give a recommended reserve slot size (gpu-weeks and burst profile)?
- Kimberly: if we decided on the conservative reserve (scenario A) vs aggressive reserve (scenario B), what lead time would infra need to commit GPUs and what SLA delta do we expect?
- I looped in OrbitAI (Joe/Linda) so they can confirm the forecast by Wednesday.

Proposed next steps: quick call today 11:30 PT (30m) to align and then a Friday 10am PT sign-off with Finance if the numbers look sane.

Attachments: Q4_pipeline_snapshot.xlsx, Reserve_ask_template.docx, runway_model_v3.csv

Thanks,
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Joe Thompson <joe.thompson@orbitai.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 09:01:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Reserve runway bake-off: weekly capacity & commercial triggers

Rafael — quick read-through. I pulled the OrbitAI row and ran the burn assumptions through runway_model_v3.csv. High level:
- Scenario A (conservative): reserve 4 reserved GPU-weeks per month, plus burst allowance of 2 GPUs for peak windows.
- Scenario B (aggressive): reserve 12 reserved GPU-weeks per month, burst allowance 6 GPUs.

Notes: OrbitAI's embed-heavy pipeline increases token IO; cost projections in the sheet assume quantized LLM v1.2. If OrbitAI insists on lower latency (p99 target < 150ms) they'd need the aggressive profile.

I'll be on the 11:30 call.

—Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Sales Operations

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Linda Wu <linda.wu@orbitai.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 10:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Reserve runway bake-off: weekly capacity & commercial triggers

Thanks Rafael — I updated tab "OrbitAI" with burn and revenue pacing assumptions. Two commercial items to flag: 
1) If OrbitAI wants a monthly cadence vs annual commit, Finance flags higher unit pricing; need to know their preferred billing cadence before Friday sign-off.
2) For the conservative reserve we can include a quarterly re-eval clause in the contract to ramp — lowers near-term fiscal exposure.

I've also added suggested package names (Reserve-Small, Reserve-Medium) to make the Offer cleaner for legal.

Laura
Head of Sales Finance

Rafael/Ben/Laura — infra readout:
- Lead time: for reserved pools we need a 10 business-day lead to lock GPU provisioning and networking. For burst credits (on-hosted) we can accommodate within 48 hours but at variable latency.
- SLA delta: Scenario A -> p95 latency target relaxed by ~20ms; Scenario B -> maintain strict p95 and p99 at the cost of additional reserved infra and higher monthly commitment.
- Operational contingency: recommend adding a fallback model (quantized v1-lite) in the contract to allow burst cost savings without impacting SLAs.

I'll bring the capacity table to the 11:30 call and show the tradeoffs.

Kimberly
Director, Infrastructure Capacity Planning

Thanks all — quick clarifications from OrbitAI side: 
- The product team prefers Scenario B if the price delta is <12% vs Scenario A. They need the aggressive headroom for a feature toggle we plan to flip mid-January.
- Billing cadence: prefer monthly to preserve cash flexibility. Can you send two quotes (monthly and annual) in the reserve template?
- Confirmed: Linda will validate the forecast on Wednesday after internal review.

Joe
